_comment: Resolume Arena's OSC output supports exactly ONE target (Preferences/osc.xml has a single <Output> element). This relay fans it out. Point Resolume's OSC Output at the 'listen' address below and it reaches every destination. Ports are per-destination: the Deck's TouchOSC receives on 7002, the iPad's on 7001 (verified live 2026-08-06). Neither .tosc patch needs changing.
